primary_title: TSLP promotes IL-3-independent basophil hematopoiesis and type 2 inflammation
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows TSLP acts directly on bone-marrow-resident progenitors to promote basophil maturation/hematopoiesis.
limitations_preserved: Preserve mouse progenitor and TSLP-transgenic context; this is a hematopoietic functional bridge, not a claim that TSLP directly induces basophil cytokine secretion or a SCI inference.
